# maroa.ai
> AI marketing operations software with compliance refusal and
> approval gates. $149 Growth / $599 Agency / Enterprise custom.
> Cancel-anytime monthly billing. No free tier, no trial.

## Plans
- [Growth](https://maroa.ai/pricing): $149/mo, single business
- [Agency](https://maroa.ai/pricing): $599/mo, up to 5 brands
- [Enterprise](https://maroa.ai/contact?topic=enterprise): custom, 10+ brands or SSO/BAA

## Key features
- Compliance refusal (FDA, FTC, FCA, platform policy)
- Reasoning trace on every piece of content
- Daily ad audit with anti-thrashing
- Approval gate (nothing auto-publishes)
- Auto-safe banding (green/yellow/red risk)
- Pacing alerts every 4h
- Voice signature with drift detection
- Cultural calendar (28 countries)
- AI-SEO + CRO audits
- Competitor war room
